title: Diamond and Suslin trees: prediction and construction
summary: Diamond implies CH and anticipates maximal antichains in a recursive construction of a Suslin tree.
abstract: Diamond asserts that a single sequence can anticipate every subset of the first uncountable ordinal, by making one guess for each countable initial segment. For every subset, the indices where the guesses are correct must meet every closed unbounded set. Assuming diamond, the real line has the same size as the set of countable ordinals, and there is a Suslin tree. Such a tree has first uncountable height, yet every chain of comparable nodes and every antichain of mutually incomparable nodes is countable.
